verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments platform, and a buyer could fairly ask whether it can be operated through natural-language commands, so the axis applies. The pack shows no natural-language interface, AI assistant, or agent for operating the product. The llms.txt and markdown docs only make the documentation readable by LLMs, an adjacent capability that earns no credit for natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
